scope: Gate2 declarative runtime boundary only; no migration, runtime implementation, or production cutover

environmentContext.name: EnvironmentContext
forbidden: using NODE_ENV as an implicit database selector
using a legacy path to infer databaseIdentity

partitionRules.contextComparison: environmentCode, databaseIdentity, and requestNamespace must all match the startup context exactly
partitionRules.requestNamespaceMismatch: REJECT_BEFORE_CLAIM; the shared entrypoint provider must validate the formula before insert or replay lookup

startupDatabaseIdentityVerification.expected: the returned database_identity equals EnvironmentContext.databaseIdentity byte-for-byte
requiredBefore: admin or user web route registration
any repository read or write other than this verification
startupDatabaseIdentityVerification.failureMode: fail closed without registering an entrypoint or starting a mutation-capable background task

requestIdentity.storageModel: store requestNamespace, entrypointKind, externalRequestId, request_key, and requestIdentityFingerprint as separate columns; never persist an ambiguous concatenation as the unique identity
requestIdentity.payloadFingerprint: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hex of the entrypoint-normalized mutation payload
requestIdentity.normalization: entrypoint adapters must supply a stable externalRequestId; repositories may not invent or rewrite it

requestKey.semantics: human-auditable adapter idempotency key scoped by request_namespace; it is not the cross-environment unique key and must not be hashed or rewritten by a repository

requestIdentityFingerprint.canonicalInput: UTF-8 JSON array with no whitespace and this exact order: [requestNamespace,entrypointKind,externalRequestId]
requestIdentityFingerprint.persistenceRole: the UNIQUE lookup key for claim acquisition and replay

requestIdentity.collisionRule: same requestIdentityFingerprint and same payloadFingerprint replays; same requestIdentityFingerprint and different payloadFingerprint rejects

allowedTransitions.condition: the persisted route is MODERN or LEGACY_FALLBACK, the selected route is mutation-capable for this request, and its sole writer is immediately about to perform the first write
the persisted route completes with zero writes: MODERN read, SHADOW comparison, REJECT, or explicitly read-only LEGACY_FALLBACK handoff
routing, authorization, validation, or pre-mutation execution fails closed
the selected writer commits its transaction and durable receipt
the selected writer rolls back or records a terminal failure

singleWriterClaim.concurrency: exactly one entrypoint claim may own a requestIdentityFingerprint; all contenders read the persisted claim
singleWriterClaim.mutationBoundary: the entrypoint changes CLAIMED to MUTATION_STARTED immediately before the first mutation and no participant may do so independently

routeDecision.replay: an existing claim returns its stored route decision without consulting rollout, canary, aliases, or current configuration again

shadow.completion: compare modern read projection with the legacy read projection, write only canonical_app_wiring_operations control-plane claim/result fields, and transition CLAIMED to COMPLETED

legacyFallback.allowedOnlyWhen: the persisted route is LEGACY_FALLBACK; a read-only handoff may finish CLAIMED->COMPLETED, while a mutation-capable handoff must first transition CLAIMED->MUTATION_STARTED immediately before its first write
legacyFallback.modernFailure: FAILED; never invoke legacy as recovery

claimReplayStore.purpose: one shared entrypoint-owned claim, stored route decision, state transition, and replay result for IRIS, AUTOMATIC, ADMIN, and WEB
requiredColumns: app_wiring_operation_id CHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
request_identity_fingerprint CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
payload_fingerprint CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
claimReplayStore.unmatchedReject: route REJECT may persist with both command_code and handler_key NULL because classification can fail before either identifier exists
claimReplayStore.namespaceInvariant: request_namespace must equal CONCAT('hoibot:', environment_code, ':', database_identity); reject before claim on mismatch
claimReplayStore.ownership: entrypoint boundary only; SQL domain repositories are transaction participants and cannot acquire or mutate this claim independently
claimReplayStore.migrationRule: add through a new unapplied migration owned by the shared provider; never edit an applied migration

may: execute reads and writes selected by the entrypoint-owned transaction

observed: pool database is configured from DatabaseConfig.name
sourceEvidence.blockingReason: configured and connected database identities are not compared before use

observed: admin web routes are registered directly
CommandDispatcher is constructed in Iris request processing
automatic maintenance timers are started directly
missingRequired: entrypoint-owned single-writer claim shared by IRIS/AUTOMATIC/ADMIN/WEB
sourceEvidence.blockingReason: entrypoints can reach repositories without one common claim and environment boundary

observed: resolve reads current command definition before recording
record uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE without loading the stored route
sourceEvidence.blockingReason: a retry can recompute routing instead of replaying its original writer selection

missingRequired: binding either legacy root to the verified database identity through EnvironmentContext
sourceEvidence.blockingReason: legacy path selection and SQL identity are not one immutable partition decision

gate2Decision.promotionRequirement: implement and test the full boundary for IRIS, AUTOMATIC, ADMIN, and WEB before changing status
